# gramlot-js-server 0.3.15

Align the Node/Bun host, serverless exporter and project creator at 0.3.15. Reuse page grammars, load only page-declared collections and serve verified immutable collection resources. Carry TYTX companion data through hosted and offline gallery pages, including guided playback and file-based carousel fixes.

The prepared Python page exporter is not included.
